english.title: Owner-driver failing to complete a drivers record book before use

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an owner-driver, failed to enter or secure that there was entered on the front sheet of your driver's record book the information specified in items 4 and 6 of that sheet before the book was used
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(2) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an owner-driver
failed to enter/secure entry on
front sheet of driver's record book
information specified in items 4 and 6

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was an owner- driver, used a driver's record book when the information prescribed by regulation was not entered on its front sheet in that **(..SPECIFY MISSING DETAIL(S)..) had not been completed.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
